name: Watashi no Alice
source:
My little brother's name is Alice.
Unlike me, he is beautiful.
Unlike me, everyone loves him.
Unlike me, he is innocent and sweet.
I am not like Alice.
Because every night, I have the same dream...
translation:
我弟弟的名字叫爱丽丝。
与我不同，他很漂亮。
与我不同，每个人都爱他。
与我不同的是，他天真可爱。
我不像爱丽丝。
因为每天晚上我都会做同一个梦……
